translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "In northern Jiangsu, Tongzhou alone remains intact; it and Changzhou and Zhaoshu depend on one another like lip and teeth.

sentences.zh: 在籍布政使徐宗幹廉能素著，請飭令督辦通、泰一路捐輸，並會籌常、昭防剿。」

translations.literal: Retired Financial Commissioner Xu Zonggan is widely known for integrity and ability. I ask that he be ordered to supervise donations along the Tongzhou–Taizhou route and jointly plan the defense and suppression of Changzhou and Zhaoshu.
translations.idiomatic: Retired Financial Commissioner Xu Zonggan is widely known for integrity and competence. I ask that he be ordered to supervise contributions along the Tongzhou–Taizhou route and jointly plan the defense and suppression of Changzhou and Zhaoshu.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 尋命督辦江南團練。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to supervise the Jiangnan militia.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was ordered to supervise the Jiangnan militia.

sentences.zh: 賊由江陰東竄，偪常熟，鍾璐率團勇數戰，亡其精銳，奏請江北諸軍速援。

translations.literal: Rebels fled east from Jiangyin and pressed on Changshu. Zhonglu led the militia in several battles, losing his best troops, and memorialized for swift aid from northern Jiangsu armies.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels broke east from Jiangyin and pressed on Changshu. Zhonglu led the militia in several battles, losing his best troops, and memorialized asking the northern Jiangsu armies to come quickly to their aid.

sentences.zh: 上以水陸各軍勢難兼顧，溫詔慰勉。

translations.literal: The throne replied that the river and land forces could hardly cover both fronts, and sent a warm edict of encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: The throne replied that the river and land forces could hardly attend to both fronts at once, and sent a warm edict of encouragement.

sentences.zh: 八月，賊陷常熟，鍾璐奏自劾，並請飭荊州將軍都興阿統楚師兼程進駐通州防北竄，上責令規复。

translations.literal: In the eighth month rebels took Changshu. Zhonglu memorialized to impeach himself and asked that General Duxing'a of Jingzhou lead Hubei troops at forced march to garrison Tongzhou against a northern incursion. The throne rebuked him and ordered recovery of the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month rebels took Changshu. Zhonglu memorialized to impeach himself and asked that General Duxing'a of Jingzhou lead Hubei troops at forced march to garrison Tongzhou and guard against a northern incursion. The throne rebuked him and ordered the city recovered.

sentences.zh: 鍾璐自崇明赴上海，設局勸捐，集團守禦。

translations.literal: Zhonglu went from Chongming to Shanghai, set up bureaus to solicit donations, and gathered militia for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Zhonglu went from Chongming to Shanghai, set up bureaus to solicit contributions, and gathered militia for defense.

sentences.zh: 薦上海知縣劉郇膏循聲卓著，為江南州縣之冠，報聞。

translations.literal: He recommended Shanghai Magistrate Liu Xinggao, whose reputation for good governance was outstanding and the best among Jiangnan prefectures and counties. The recommendation was reported.
translations.idiomatic: He recommended Shanghai Magistrate Liu Xinggao, whose reputation for upright governance was outstanding and the finest among Jiangnan prefectures and counties. The recommendation was reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 又以軍需餉急，奏請令失守地方官罰鍰免治罪，諭有「捐輸巨款、募勇殺賊、隨官兵克復城池者，得據實聲明請旨」。

translations.literal: Because military funds were urgently needed, he memorialized that officials who had lost their posts pay fines in lieu of punishment, with an edict that those who donated heavily, raised troops to kill rebels, or joined the army in recovering cities could report the facts and request imperial consideration.
translations.idiomatic: Because military funds were urgently needed, he memorialized that officials who had lost their posts might pay fines in lieu of punishment, with an edict stating that those who contributed large sums, raised troops to kill rebels, or joined the army in recovering cities could report the facts and request imperial consideration.

sentences.zh: 尋奏言：「賊所脅之眾數百萬人，何一非皇上赤子？

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized: "The millions coerced by the rebels—are they not every one the Emperor's own children?
translations.idiomatic: Soon he memorialized: "The millions coerced by the rebels—are they not every one the Emperor's own children?

sentences.zh: 若非設法解散，窮無所歸，必鋌而走險。

translations.literal: If we do not find a way to disband them, with nowhere to turn they will surely take desperate risks.
translations.idiomatic: If we do not find a way to disband them, with nowhere else to turn they will surely take desperate risks.

sentences.zh: 請明降諭旨，予以自新，釋兵歸降者勿殺，薙發投順者勿殺。

translations.literal: I ask that a clear edict be issued offering them a chance to reform: those who lay down arms and surrender are not to be killed; those who shave their heads and submit are not to be killed.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that a clear edict be issued offering them a chance to reform: those who lay down arms and surrender are not to be killed, and those who shave their heads and submit are not to be killed.

sentences.zh: 又陷賊州縣，多設立偽官，迫索錢米，以減輕田賦，搖動人心。

translations.literal: In counties fallen to the rebels, many false officials have been installed who extort grain and money by promising reduced land tax, shaking people's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: In counties fallen to the rebels, many false officials have been installed who extort grain and money by promising reduced land tax, unsettling the people.

sentences.zh: 歷來被兵州縣，錢糧均奉恩旨蠲免。

translations.literal: Throughout history, counties ravaged by war have had their grain and tax payments remitted by imperial grace.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout history, counties ravaged by war have had their grain and tax payments remitted by imperial grace.

sentences.zh: 此次蘇省被賊，戶口散亡，收復之後，無從徵收，不如施恩於未復之先，使愚民不為所惑。」

translations.literal: This time Jiangsu has been overrun: populations scattered and dead. After recovery, collection will be impossible anyway. Better to grant the favor before recovery, so the simple people are not misled.
translations.idiomatic: This time Jiangsu has been overrun: populations scattered and lost. Even after recovery, collection will be impossible. Better to grant the favor before recovery, so that simple people are not misled.

sentences.zh: 詔如所請。

translations.literal: The edict approved his request.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved his request.

sentences.zh: 十一年春，賊自平湖、乍浦窺金山，鍾璐督團勇進擊，斬馘甚眾。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eleventh year rebels from Pinghu and Zhapu probed Jinshan. Zhonglu directed the militia in attack and killed many.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eleventh year rebels from Pinghu and Zhapu probed Jinshan. Zhonglu directed the militia in attack and killed many.

sentences.zh: 新埭賊擾大泖港，楓涇賊窺角鉤灣，復會官兵破之。

translations.literal: Rebels at Xindai harassed Damao Harbor; rebels at Fengjing probed Jiaogou Bay. He joined regular troops again and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels at Xindai harassed Damao Harbor, and rebels at Fengjing probed Jiaogou Bay. He joined regular troops again and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，以蘇、常淪陷，吳民待援，有逾飢渴，复疏請敕曾國籓分兵急取蘇、常。

translations.literal: That winter, with Suzhou and Changzhou fallen and the people of Wu awaiting aid beyond thirst, he again memorialized urging Zeng Guofan to detach troops and swiftly recover Suzhou and Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, with Suzhou and Changzhou fallen and the people of Wu awaiting relief with a hunger beyond thirst, he again memorialized urging Zeng Guofan to detach troops and swiftly recover Suzhou and Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 與江蘇諸士紳貽書國籓，言：「上海餉源重地，請以奇兵萬人，一勇將統之，倍道而來，可當十萬之用。」

translations.literal: With Jiangsu gentry he wrote to Guofan: "Shanghai is a vital source of supplies. Send ten thousand elite troops under one brave general, marching at forced speed—they will count for a hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Jiangsu gentry he wrote to Guofan: "Shanghai is a vital source of supplies. Send ten thousand elite troops under one brave general, marching at forced speed—they will count for a hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 國籓乃遣李鴻章率師浮江而東。

translations.literal: Guofan then sent Li Hongzhang to lead an army east down the river.
translations.idiomatic: Guofan then sent Li Hongzhang to lead an army east down the river.

sentences.zh: 俄、法兩國請助兵討寇，鍾璐奏言：「中國平內亂，原無待藉手外人，而值賊勢蔓延，兵力單薄，不能不為從權之計。

translations.literal: Russia and France offered troops to help suppress the rebels. Zhonglu memorialized: "China quelling internal disorder ought not to need foreign hands. Yet with rebels spreading and forces thin, we cannot but adopt expedients.
translations.idiomatic: Russia and France offered troops to help suppress the rebels. Zhonglu memorialized: "China ought to be able to quell internal disorder without foreign help. Yet with rebels spreading and forces thin, we must adopt expedients.

sentences.zh: 惟外人助攻，為通商而起，必先自有把握，方裨大局。」

translations.literal: Only foreign assistance arises from trade interests; we must first have our own control before it can aid the larger cause.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign assistance arises from trade interests; we must first have our own control before it can truly serve the larger cause.

sentences.zh: 諭江蘇巡撫薛煥妥籌酌行。

translations.literal: An edict instructed Governor Xue Huan of Jiangsu to arrange matters properly.
translations.idiomatic: An edict instructed Governor Xue Huan of Jiangsu to arrange matters properly.

sentences.zh: 尋裁各省團練大臣，召還京，再授內閣學士。

translations.literal: Soon the provincial militia commissioners were abolished; he was recalled to the capital and again appointed Grand Secretary of the Inner Cabinet.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the provincial militia commissioners were abolished. He was recalled to the capital and again appointed Grand Secretary of the Inner Cabinet.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，遷禮部侍郎，迭署工、吏諸部，督順天學政。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he was transferred to Vice Minister of Rites, served in succession as acting head of Works, Personnel, and other ministries, and supervised the Shuntian examinations.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Tongzhi reign he was transferred to Vice Minister of Rites, served in succession as acting head of Works, Personnel, and other ministries, and supervised the Shuntian examinations.

sentences.zh: 四年，呈所纂文廟祀典考。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he submitted his compiled Inquiry into the Rites of the Confucian Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he submitted his compiled Inquiry into the Rites of the Confucian Temple.

sentences.zh: 六年夏，畿輔亢旱，疏陳荒政十事，下部議行。

translations.literal: In the summer of the sixth year the capital region suffered severe drought. He memorialized ten points on famine administration; the ministries deliberated and implemented them.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the sixth year the capital region suffered severe drought. He memorialized ten points on famine administration, and the ministries deliberated and put them into practice.

sentences.zh: 命偕大學士賈楨等督五城團防，歷戶、兵、吏諸部。

translations.literal: He was ordered with Grand Secretary Jia Zhen and others to supervise the Five-City militia defenses, and served in Revenue, War, Personnel, and other ministries.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered, together with Grand Secretary Jia Zhen and others, to supervise the Five-City militia defenses, and served in Revenue, War, Personnel, and other ministries.

sentences.zh: 九年，擢左都御史，署工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief and served as Acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief and served as Acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十年，授刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was appointed Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，歸。

translations.literal: He returned home upon his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: He returned home to mourn his mother.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，卒，諡文恪。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he died and was posthumously titled Wénkè.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Guangxu reign he died and was posthumously honored with the title Wénkè, "Cultured and Respectful."

sentences.zh: 子鴻文，光緒二年進士；

translations.literal: His son Hongwen passed the jinshi in the second year of Guangxu;
translations.idiomatic: His son Hongwen passed the jinshi examination in the second year of the Guangxu reign;

sentences.zh: 鴻書，光緒六年進士：同官翰林院編修。

translations.literal: Hongshu in the sixth year of Guangxu; both served as Compilers in the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Hongshu in the sixth year of the Guangxu reign; both served as Compilers in the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 鴻文至通政司副使，鴻書至貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: Hongwen rose to Vice Transmission Commissioner; Hongshu became Governor of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwen rose to Vice Transmission Commissioner; Hongshu became Governor of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: =【論】=論曰：同治初政，沈兆霖、曹毓瑛入贊樞府，兆霖暫領陝督，督師定西寧，以死勤事；

translations.literal: Commentary: In the early Tongzhi reign, Shen Zhaolin and Cao Yuying entered the Grand Council. Zhaolin briefly held Shaanxi, directed the army to pacify Xining, and died in service.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary says: In the early Tongzhi reign, Shen Zhaolin and Cao Yuying entered the Grand Council. Zhaolin briefly held Shaanxi, directed the army to pacify Xining, and died in the performance of his duties.

sentences.zh: 毓瑛慎密練達，克副簡拔。

translations.literal: Yuying was careful, thorough, and seasoned, fully worthy of his selection.
translations.idiomatic: Yuying was careful, thorough, and seasoned, fully worthy of the selection that had elevated him.

sentences.zh: 許乃普等皆以清謹負時望，鄭敦謹尤易攵歷有名績。

translations.literal: Xu Naipu and others were all known for integrity and won public esteem; Zheng Dunjin especially accumulated distinguished achievements through many posts.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Naipu and the others were all known for integrity and commanded public esteem; Zheng Dunjin in particular built a record of distinction through many posts.

sentences.zh: 江寧之獄，論者多謂未盡得其情，敦謹未覆命，遽解官以去，其亦有所未慊於衷歟？

translations.literal: In the Jiangning case, many commentators say the full truth was never reached. Dunjin resigned his post before reporting back—did he too leave with something unresolved in his heart?
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiangning case, many commentators hold that the full truth was never reached. Dunjin resigned before reporting back—did he too leave with something still unresolved in his heart?
